name: 3C | Illuminati OG | 8th
description:
GENETICS: OG Kush
ORIGIN: Bryan’s Personal Original 1996 OG Cut
AROMA: Piney, Gas, Skunky
EFFECT: Well-Rounded, Euphoric, Cerebral
TERPENES: 
β-Caryophyllene: anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. Relieve anxiety and pain, reduce cholesterol, prevent Osteoporosis, and treat seizures.
β-Myrcene: improve sleep, reduce pain, promote relaxation, enhance mood, relieve anxiety, relieve stress, strengthen the immune system.
δ-Limonene: boost mood, relieve stress, create sense of euphoria. Antifungal and antibacterial properties. May help relieve heartburn and gastric reflux.

DESCRIPTION: The original OG Kush’s story is shrouded in mystery, just like the Illuminati… Our part of the story comes into play in the late 90’s when we were gifted an original cut of the OG Kush. The iconic skunk, gas and pine aromas and flavors have kept this strain as a staple in our strain library ever since. Its triangle shaped buds have orange red hairs bursting through the bright green nodules giving it the quintessential look of top shelf cannabis. Its well rounded effects provide users with a cerebral and euphoric head high that is mirrored by a comforting, almost couch locked body high.

CONSPIRACY: The Illuminati are suspected by many to be plotting the creation of a New World Order, a singular, all-powerful world government. Many populists, such as members of the John Birch Society believe that some collegiate fraternities, such as the Skull and Bones of Yale, gentlemen's clubs, such as the Bohemian Club, and think tanks such as the Council on Foreign Relations and the Trilateral Commission, are just front organizations of the Illuminati. 
Note: THC% may vary batch to batch.
